column1: # Sample of a generated lexicon, for reference only.
# tools/build_lexicon.py writes from the Wiktionary dump and a frequency
# table. The real files are tens to hundreds of thousands of lines and live
# outside this repository; see docs/LEXICON.md for how to build them.
# Read it for the shape of the output: a frequency-derived WEIGHT on every
# line, an orthographic stem class rather than an IRR_* one, explicit
# FEATURE=form for whatever that class does not predict ("go" keeping "went"
# and "gone"), and UNKNOWN where the source listed no inflection at all.
